comparison.objective: Install a keyed magnetic encoder carrier and guided sensor bracket, close its catch, and run a field check.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed insertion, guide-post placement, latching, and diagnostic actuation rather than coaxial two-tool screw/nut locking.
comparison.success_condition: Carrier and bracket seated, catch closed, field check passed, and hands clear; its rubric omits detailed numeric seating tolerances.
comparison.reason: Despite shared robot-component setup and post-installation verification, it tests component insertion and retention rather than setting preservation under tightening torque.
